instruction.name: xvftintrpl.l.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in lower part of every 128-bit vector of `a` to signed 64-bit integer, rounding towards positive infinity.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftintrpl.l.s $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvftintrpl.l.s $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrpl.l.s $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. Extra counters per instruction (normalized by 8 lanes): 0xfa=2.00.

notes: LASX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
